exposure: umbilical artery blood flow pulsatility index (PI)
umbilical artery systolic and diastolic velocity (S/D)
aortic arch isthmus peak systolic velocity (PSV)/end-systolic reflux velocity (ESRV)
cohort: A cohort of 150 pregnant women, 75 with fetuses diagnosed with FGR and 75 with healthy fetuses, who received prenatal examination from January 2021 to August 2023.
finding: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) is associated with specific hemodynamic changes in the umbilical artery, middle cerebral artery, and aortic arch isthmus, as measured by Color Doppler Ultrasound, and these parameters are sensitive indices for assessing FGR and predicting severe hypoxia.
